review_kind: Eight complete source-vetted requirement, issue and developer documentation packages; NOT governed review
macro_findings: Eight genuine unreviewed first-class packages, all single-file SKILL.md trees, reviewed at one pinned MIT source revision with exact per-skill blob/tree and 10-dimension rationales.
Three GitHub issue generators have a systemic authority hard fail: search-before-create is not authorization to publish, update or notify; also no partial-failure handling.

Technical spike instructions escalate from planning to prototypes, network fetch and file edits without separate consent. TLDR example normalizes destructive git reset/clean commands. These five are REJECT unchanged.

Three reference-only checklists (specification, C# docs, C# async) retain useful drafting guidance; C# async contains overbroad exception-handling rules, and no package is approved unchanged or behaviorally validated.

The eight cover product requirements, planning, technical writing and backend review. Overlap with governed and candidate examples remains a separate semantic question; no eligible distinct denominator is inferred.
